spec.title: PROP-082 — Package initialization scaffold
spec.p: This proposal specifies the authored package fields produced by `vibe init package`. PROP-009 defines what a boot link does after installation; PROP-035 defines the meaning and absent-field default of a package format. Neither chooses the fields written by this command.

p.INIT-PACKAGE-SCAFFOLD: For a new package, `vibe init package <group>/<name> [dir]` records the selected boot link and package format in the generated package `vibe.toml`. An already existing package manifest is kept rather than silently rewritten to new defaults. The generated fields describe this package; they do not migrate an installed 1.0.x package or change an existing user's authored manifest.

p.INIT-PACKAGE-LINK: The package form defaults its generated `[boot_snippet].link` to `dynamic`. An explicit `--link static` or `--link dynamic` controls that field; another link value is refused before writing the package manifest. The project-and-package scaffold form retains its separate `static` default. The resulting link semantics are those of PROP-009 `#LINK-STATIC` and `#LINK-DYNAMIC`.

p.INIT-PACKAGE-FORMAT: The generated package manifest explicitly writes `format = "normal"` when no format is selected; an explicit `--format simple` or `--format normal` writes that selected value. This scaffold default is distinct from PROP-035's `simple` interpretation of a pre-existing manifest with no format field. Initialization does not reinterpret such a manifest or rewrite its files.
